QuestInfo.name: Nella's Scheme
QuestInfo.0: Nella has a job for you.
QuestInfo.1:
Nella wants you to #bcapture 10 Ligators#k in the Swamp Region...for some reason.

#rTip. How to Capture Monsters#k
: When you're near the Ligators, click the black pouch Nella gave you to capture them.
QuestInfo.2: You captured 10 Ligators and gave them to Nella. It's smart to give a child live monsters, right? ...Right?!

0.0: What do you say to doing just one assignment?\nThis job's secret, okay? Don't tell ANYONE about it. This time, you're going to the Swamp Region and capturing 10 Ligators alive. Can you handle it?

yes.0: Take this black pouch. Approach a Ligator and double-click on the pouch. BAM! Ligator-in-a-bag. You can handle that, right?

no.0: Where else am I going to find someone to do this on short notice? Whatever. Just make sure you keep this to yourself!

yes.0: Nice! Remember, don't tell a soul about this. Take care!

item.0: Capturing 10 Ligators should be simple enough! If you're out of Black Pouches already, just forfeit the job and talk to me again.

lost.0: Here are some more pouches. Just hurry, okay?
